title: Experimental handoff briefs and alert playbook slate
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design an experimental surface that combines a compact on-call handoff brief with an alert provisioning playbook slate. Goals: reduce cognitive load during shift changes, surface SLO-relevant playback for recent breaches, and make it trivial to attach postmortem links and create an initial postmortem draft. The prototype explores three patterns: (1) a lightweight horizontal 'brief card' that summarizes the last 3 incidents and next steps, (2) a modal-first alert provisioning flow that previews SLO impact via a small time-series scrubber and predicted noise rate, and (3) an automated postmortem action that drafts a Confluence page and populates it with incident metadata and links to the runbook. This ticket captures the UX mocks, feedback from PM/ENG reviews, accessibility notes, and the follow-up tasks for engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Brief card displays incident title, time, severity, and one-line recommended action
SLO scrubber shows last 7 days with breach thumbnails and hover tooltips explaining cause tags
Alert provisioning flow previews estimated false-positive rate and offers a 'playbook attach' toggle
Postmortem draft action creates a Confluence draft with incident metadata and a one-click copy of important links
Design passes a 1-hour feasibility sync with ENG and accessibility checklist reviewed
